description: Defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'TimesheetActionLogSearchFilterParams' used for filtering search parameters related to timesheet action logs in the OrangeHRM system. The class extends 'FilterParams' and sets a default sort field for the search.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters and sorting options for timesheet action log searches.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field set to 'timesheetActionLog.date'.
